requirements.text: Policy-required new_session/context_refresh boundaries should be executed by the agent/adapter automatically when host capabilities allow, without asking the user to paste or press Enter on a command.
If host limitations prevent automatic session creation/reset, CodeWiki must record a precise platform block/fallback instead of presenting the compatibility command as normal user work.
Workflow efficiency must be a roadmap success criterion measured by fewer user interrupts, fewer manual commands, shorter closure path, clear finish reports, and bounded loop/session/write cost.
Session automation and workflow-friction reduction take priority over TASK-001 decision_build implementation until the next roadmap alignment says otherwise.
